title: Actual Insights mobile summary
description: Response of GET /api/mobile/summary, schema version 1. Amounts are integer minor units (cents). After release this schema changes additively only: new optional fields may appear, so clients must ignore properties they do not know. This file describes exactly what the server sends today, which is why additionalProperties is false.

generatedAt.description: When the server computed this payload (UTC). The server may reuse a payload for up to 60 seconds.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the budget's default currency; USD when the budget does not say.

month.description: The current calendar month's budget. Null when it could not be read.

label.description: YYYY-MM. Localize it in the app.

budgeted.description: Sum of this month's budgeted amounts over spending categories (income and transfer groups excluded).

spent.description: Positive spending so far, net of refunds, over the same categories.

remaining.description: Money left to spend, carryover included. Negative when over budget.

daysLeft.description: Days after today in the month; 0 on the last day.

pace.description: Spending against the share of the month gone, with a 10% tolerance: under = behind pace, on = on pace, over = ahead of pace or over budget.

projection.description: Projected end-of-month net. Null when it could not be computed.

monthEndNet.description: Income minus spending projected to month end. Negative means a projected shortfall.

accounts.description: Open on-budget accounts by name, at most 25.

balance.description: Null when the balance could not be read.

upcoming.description: Scheduled bills and paychecks in the next 7 days, soonest first, at most 10. Transfers between your own accounts that are not payments are left out.

amount.description: Always positive; kind says which direction the money moves.

forecast.description: Cash-flow forecast headline. Null when no account is switched on for the forecast, or it could not be computed.

status.description: low when any watched account drops below its warning level in the window.

lowestBalance.description: The lowest projected balance of the account named in accountName (the one furthest below its level when status is low).

goals.description: Savings goals in the order they were created, at most 5.
